name: renku-plugin
description: Graph-based video generation workflows for Renku.

interface.shortDescription: Build narrated video pipelines from reusable blueprints.
interface.longDescription: Renku is a graph-based media build tool for generating videos from reusable blueprints. It composes prompts, images, video segments, narration, music, and timeline assembly through dependency-driven workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use Renku to design a documentary blueprint with narration and music.
Use Renku to choose producers and models for a short-form video pipeline.
Use Renku to revise this blueprint's prompts and inputs for a new ad concept.
